subject.size_in_frame: starts filling the middle of frame at about 0.40 of frame height and is left small at the bottom of it, about 0.16, as the frame climbs away from him

headroom: starts at about 0.24 of frame height and is torn open by the two-step tilt to about 0.70 — and there is still nothing at the top of it. The failure of the headroom to arrive at a face is the shot.
horizon_eyeline: Water-level start at 0.10 m with the waterline at 0.62 of frame height; the tilt takes that line down out of frame. His eyeline goes up, stops, goes up again — and the exact eyeline to where her head would be is far above the top edge and is never reached. No lamp enters frame at any point in the climb.

layers.fg: the water and his own ripples at the start, gone by the end of the move
layers.mg: the Rabbit looking up, and up, and flinching violently backward
layers.bg: the dark hall, then a wall of blue cotton, then black — the frame runs out of information as it rises

gaze.note: his look is the move. The lead room the tilt opens is deliberately empty: it finds her body, then more of her body, and then dark, and it never finds her face. His flinch is what ends it.

balance: Starts balanced on him and ends abandoned — a small animal at the bottom of a frame that has gone looking for something and failed. The imbalance at the end is the point and is not corrected.
leading_lines: The vertical of her body, entering the frame as a featureless blue plane, is the only line the tilt has to climb, and it goes off the top edge unresolved.
eye_first: His face at the start — the once in the episode it is given — then up with his look into nothing.
constraint_binding: The episode's ONE two-step camera move, and it must run out of room BEFORE any lamp fixture could enter frame: the tilt starts from a lens at 0.10 m and stops at an angle that still keeps the 2.30 m lamp line outside the top edge. His face is spent here, once, in the whole episode. QUADRUPED RABBIT throughout.
start_end_framing: Start: waterline at 0.62, him centred at 0.40 of frame height, his own ripples in the near foreground. End: waterline gone, him small at the bottom edge, the upper two thirds of frame filled by an unreadable blue mass and black above it.
